description.value: Praise for THE SCIENCE OF SUCCESS    "Evaluating the success of an individual or company is a lot like judging a trapper by his pelts. Charles Koch has a lot of pelts. He has built Koch Industries into the world's largest privately held company, and this book is an insider's guide to how he did it. Koch has studied how markets work for decades, and his commitment to pass that knowledge on will inspire entrepreneurs for generations to come."  --T. Boone Pickens   "A must-read for entrepreneurs and corporate executives that is also applicable to the wider world. MBM is an invaluable tool for engendering excellence for all groups, from families to nonprofit entities. Government leaders could avoid policy failures by heeding the science of human behavior."  --Richard L. Sharp, Chairman, CarMax   "My father, Sam Walton, stressed the importance of fundamental principles--such as humility, integrity, respect, and creating value...
